headline: 9-wicket win: Bangladesh annihilates Australia in historic Darwin Test
summary: The Tigers deliver the greatest Test victory in the country's history, dominating the hosts on their own soil with a day and a session to spare.
details: Bangladesh achieved a historic nine-wicket victory over Australia in the Darwin Test, marking the greatest Test win in the nation's history. The Tigers dominated the match from the first session, winning inside four days.
Australia, the overwhelming favorites, fielded a full-strength side but were outplayed in nearly every session. Bangladesh chased a target of 57 to seal the emociones victory comfortably.
The result has been widely described as a 'shock' or 'upset' by international media, as Australia was expected to win comfortably at home.
Despite some fans' debate over the word 'upset'—since Bangladesh controlled the match—the term refers to the pre-match expectation of an Australian victory.
This victory is a landmark moment for Bangladesh cricket, reshaping their Test identity and bringing new respect from the global cricket community.
The teams now move to Mackay for the next Test, where Australia remains the stronger side on paper, but the Bangladesh team has proven their evolution.
caption:
A historic demolition! 🇧🇩

Bangladesh just crushed Australia in Darwin, producing the greatest Test victory in our history.

Bangladesh achieved a historic nine-wicket victory over Australia in the Darwin Test, marking the greatest Test win in the nation's history. The Tigers dominated the match from the first session, winning inside four days.

Australia, the overwhelming favorites, fielded a full-strength side but were outplayed in nearly every session. Bangladesh chased a target of 57 to seal the emociones victory comfortably.

The result has been widely described as a 'shock' or 'upset' by international media, as Australia was expected to win comfortably at home.

Despite some fans' debate over the word 'upset'—since Bangladesh controlled the match—the term refers to the pre-match expectation of an Australian victory.

This victory is a landmark moment for Bangladesh cricket, reshaping their Test identity and bringing new respect from the global cricket community.

The teams now move to Mackay for the next Test, where Australia remains the stronger side on paper, but the Bangladesh team has proven their evolution.

headline_marked: Up to 100% hike: [[Ninth national pay scale to be implemented]] this year
headline: Up to 100% hike: Ninth national pay scale to be implemented this year
summary: A secretary committee has recommended increasing the basic salary of government employees from grades 1 to 20 by up to 100%.
details: The government is set to implement the ninth national pay scale this year, according to Finance Minister Ahmed Hossen Goyal.
A secretary committee has recommended increasing the basic salary of government employees across grades 1 to 20 by up to 100%.
The implementation is expected to happen in two phases. In the first year, the increase in basic salary will be effective, followed by house rent and other allowances in the second year.
All members of the secretary committee have signed the final report on the proposed pay scale hike.
caption:
Government employees could see their basic salaries double. A 100% hike has been recommended for the new national pay scale.

The government is set to implement the ninth national pay scale this year, according to Finance Minister Ahmed Hossen Goyal.

A secretary committee has recommended increasing the basic salary of government employees across grades 1 to 20 by up to 100%.

The implementation is expected to happen in two phases. In the first year, the increase in basic salary will be effective, followed by house rent and other allowances in the second year.

All members of the secretary committee have signed the final report on the proposed pay scale hike.
